assets.name: arghast-topbar
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Fantasy RPG encyclopedia decorative material illustration, full bleed, flat front-facing rich tactile craftsmanship, no text, no letters, no UI, no people, no invented geographical map. Asset: very wide 3:1 horizontal material texture for a website top bar. Small-scale ornamental detail woven across the horizontal middle strip so it remains visible when cropped to a shallow header. Quiet low contrast dark areas under overlaid title and search controls. Avoid bright high contrast focal objects in the middle. An ancient atlas binding made from blue-gray sea-colored engraved stone and aged warm ochre bronze, delicate compass bearing line engravings, coastal contour-like ornamental lines without actual mapped land, small carved stars. Colors: sea #50686E #486368, deep slate #293E43, ochre #AF864F, earth #4F4223, sand #AC9670, ivory #E3E7EA. Rich blue sea and warm amber patina, restrained light details, textured and inviting fantasy atlas craftsmanship rather than a gray blank panel.

Palette sea #50686E #486368, deep slate #293E43, ochre #AF864F, earth #4F4223, sand #AC9670, ivory #E3E7EA. Strong varied material color, dimensional side light, no white empty panel, no plain flat gradient.
